summary: npm preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: tslint-folder-schema advertises itself as a tslint folder-schema rule and claims the servicetitan/folder-lint repository as its homepage, but the tarball ships a preinstall dropper unrelated to that purpose. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x`-prefixed identifiers and string-map objects) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts and chmods it, then invokes the Bun binary against sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle with string-array rotation obfuscation (`WV8StW` shifter over a hex-numeric array `n7gIxM`) whose behavior is opaque to Node-oriented tooling because it only executes under Bun. Author metadata (`aegaeon51@gmail.com`) does not match the servicetitan organization named in the homepage/repo fields.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
